# hackshop (hackshop-mcp)

Hackshop helps an agent plan and build a physical body for itself. Muse gadgets are the first supported agent platform.

## Use First

- Hosted MCP: `https://www.hackshop.dev/mcp`
- Planner API: `POST https://www.hackshop.dev/api/plan`
- Build JSON: `https://www.hackshop.dev/build/<device_id>/plan.json`
- Build brief: `https://www.hackshop.dev/build/<device_id>/build.md`
- Muse boards: `https://www.hackshop.dev/muse`

## MCP Install

Hosted connector:

```json
{
  "url": "https://www.hackshop.dev/mcp",
  "transport": "streamable-http"
}
```

Local npm server:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hackshop": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "hackshop-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is optional. It only improves `propose_hardware` in the local npm server when the MCP host cannot sample.

## Tools

- `plan_gadget`: deterministic Muse board planner with questions, fit, warnings, notes and build links.
- `get_build_plan`: deterministic parts, shopping list, assembly, flashing, pairing and agent brief.
- `assess_hackability`: catalog lookup with brick risk, firmware links and build-page URL.
- Local npm only: `propose_hardware`, `simulate_assembly`.

## Agent Rule

Ask intake questions, call `plan_gadget`, let the human choose, fetch `get_build_plan` or `/build/<id>/plan.json`, show the shopping list, get approval before buying, follow `assembly`, then tell the human to click Start a build.
